name: Owen Adams
notable_stories: Recipient of a handmade quilt from his grandmother Barbara
George Francis Adams Sr.'s golf clubs, given to John in 1980, were passed down to Brendan and then to Owen.

Barbara painted a karate boy rock and a chef rock for Owen, and he is the only grandchild who asked her to knit more sweaters after she made him a sweater and hat; he used to answer 'me too' to 'I love you'.
sources: John Howard Adams, "John Howard Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
